title: Reino dos Seis Portões — opção A

items.name: Castelo
items.brief: A compact but majestic medieval cream-gray stone castle, centered frontal symmetric composition. Four defensive round towers with royal blue conical roofs, central hall with blue tiled gables, arched oak entrance, tiny blue/gold heraldic banners. Taller and more substantial than shops, clear wall mass, no enormous individual bricks. No bridge or moat.

items.name: Guilda dos Aventureiros
items.brief: A prominent medieval adventurers guildhall, broad burgundy red tiled roof, cream plaster with heavy warm oak beams, handsome central double oak door, two amber lit windows, tasteful blue/gold shield with crossed swords and a small plain wooden quest notice board with blank papers (no legible writing). Distinctive guild identity, no external courtyard.

items.name: Taverna do Descanso
items.brief: The blue-roof cozy tavern from column A of the style reference: substantial royal blue tiled front gable, cream plaster and dark warm beams, arched wood entrance, amber windows, little balcony/porch detail, one compact mug symbol hanging sign, two normal small barrels and a flower box. Roof blue and wide, substantial full-height facade.

items.name: Armazém
items.brief: A robust wide medieval warehouse with dark warm brown tiled roof, cream stone base and oak bracing. Large double plank loading doors facing front, small upper storage window. Two modest shipping crates and one small barrel beside the facade, not huge. The doors can fit a handcart. No grain bundles: distinguish this warehouse from a granary.

items.name: Quartel
items.brief: A long stout medieval barracks, silver charcoal slate pitched roof, cream-gray masonry and oak supports, central human-scale door, narrow amber windows, small blue and gold banners and a shield symbol over entrance. One compact training target and small orderly weapons stand on one side, subtle and lower than the door. No soldiers.

items.name: Ferraria
items.brief: The master red-roof forge / blacksmith already created.

items.name: Madeireira
items.brief: A medieval lumber workshop like column A lower-right house: tall warm golden-brown tiled gable roof, cream plaster and dark timber facade, open front workshop entrance, small crossed axes hanging sign. Neat normal-sized logs stacked to the right BELOW window level, low carpenter bench with saw/hammer at the front, one crate. No huge timber above roof. Roof/facade dominate.

items.name: Cantaria
items.brief: A medieval stonemason workshop. Dark charcoal gray slate tiled roof, sturdy pale limestone facade with thick oak lintels, large front work opening and side amber window. A modest tidy stack of cut stone blocks no higher than half the doorway, a small stone workbench, chisels and a small hammer-and-stone hanging sign. Distinguished by stonework, not timber piles. No crane.

items.name: Curtume
items.brief: A medieval leatherworker's tannery: honey ochre tiled gable roof, warm cream plaster and dark timber, full-height front oak door and small amber window. Small tan leather hide on a wall rack, two compact wooden dye vats (burgundy and deep blue), tiny leather/apron emblem sign. Racks and vats stay BELOW facade window level. Clean charming craft shop, no animals or gore.

items.name: Alquimia
items.brief: The violet-roof potion shop in column A lower-left reference. Large rich purple tiled front gable, cream plaster and dark warm oak facade, arched wooden front door, amber/magenta window glow, purple potion bottle hanging sign. Small neatly arranged bright potion bottles on a low counter and herb flower boxes. Roof and full facade substantial, bottles tiny compared to doorway. No large magical vortex.

items.name: Encantaria
items.brief: A distinct enchanting atelier, coherent with the alchemist but different: midnight teal/indigo tiled roof with one small elegant pointed front turret, pale warm stone and dark oak facade, gold trim. Arched wood door with subtle blue glow, small square sign depicting a gold star and blue gem, two tiny amulets in a little window display, modest flower box. No giant floating book, no giant props. Full front facade.

items.name: Fazenda
items.brief: A charming small farmhouse with golden thatch roof, cream plaster and reddish oak beams, normal front plank door, tiny amber window, low side shelter. A small tidy adjoining patch of golden wheat behind a SHORT low wooden fence and a single little hay bundle. Farmhouse remains principal building, wheat subordinate. No farmer, animals, wagon or broad terrain base.

items.name: Curral
items.brief: A medieval livestock pen structure in frontal RPG projection. Low warm wooden fence enclosing a shallow rectangular pen, front swinging gate visibly open, small open-front timber livestock shelter at the back with brown pitched roof, small straw pile and water trough. See inside from same slightly elevated frontal camera. Solid wooden posts all straight, rails connect cleanly, open walking space; no animals or people, no grass/earth rectangle.

items.name: Celeiro
items.brief: A medieval grain barn / granary. Broad terracotta red pitched tiled roof, cream stone foundation, warm golden vertical wood facade with dark cross bracing. Large double barn doors, a small upper loft vent, two modest burlap grain sacks and a small bound straw bale by side. Building tall and substantial, no props exceeding lower half of door. Distinct from warehouse.

items.name: Estábulo
items.brief: A medieval timber horse stable, wide brown tiled gable roof on warm dark oak beams, cream plaster upper section, two open front horse-stall bays with waist-high half doors. Small hay bale and wooden water bucket next to entrance. See the shaded stalls and a tidy straw edge inside. No horses or people; front roof/canopy doesn't look low.

items.name: Moinho
items.brief: A charming medieval WINDMILL as a complete front-facing sprite. Pale cream cylindrical stone tower, warm brown wooden cap roof, FOUR symmetrical diagonal golden wooden sail blades mounted on the FRONT facade (not seen from overhead). Small arched wood door at ground level and a little amber window above. Roof, tower and blades fit wholly in image; two tiny grain sacks at base, no terrain.

items.name: Oficina
items.brief: A general medieval craftsman's workshop different from the dedicated blacksmith: burnt terracotta/brown tiled roof with modest chimney, pale plaster and dark oak beams, broad open front work door showing a small wood workbench, neatly hanging hammer/saw, little gear or crossed-tools sign and one small toolbox. Full visible tall facade, roof substantial, no forge flame.

items.name: Estufa
items.brief: A beautiful medieval greenhouse built from dark green painted timber and clear pale aqua glass panes. Symmetrical front gable, green-framed glass sloping roof, clearly visible full-height glazed front door, visible potted herb rows inside, two small clay pots at entrance. Same warm handcrafted pixel art as other buildings, glass is a material with light reflections, no photo, no modern metal factory.

items.name: Casa simples
items.brief: A cozy ordinary medieval cottage in the same column A village. Broad red clay tiled front gable roof and small chimney, cream plaster and dark oak beams, full-height oak front door, one small amber window each side, modest white daisy window box, tiny wood bucket. No balcony, no oversized decoration. Charming substantial facade, roof not flattened.

items.name: Casa nobre
items.brief: An elegant medieval noble townhouse, two tasteful front gables with deep royal blue tiles, cream stone and dark carved oak facade, arched double entrance, small refined upper balcony, amber leaded windows, modest blue/gold details and flower boxes. Clearly wealthier than ordinary cottage, still cozy human scale, not a second castle, no paved ground or surrounding garden.

items.name: Barraca do mercado
items.brief: One charming medieval market stall in frontal RPG view: cream/red striped cloth awning with gentle scalloped lower edge, straight warm wooden corner posts, waist-high wood counter displaying a few bright apples/vegetables, two tiny produce crates BELOW counter. Full canopy roof above normal human head height, airy open stall, no merchant, no terrain or other stalls.

items.name: Muralha
items.brief: One straight HORIZONTAL medieval stone wall segment matching the very top of column A: chunky cream-gray masonry facade, darker mortar, full straight crenellated top with alternating merlons, two modest capped end piers. Frontal elevation with a narrow top ledge visible. No archway/door/gate, no banners needed, no corner or diagonal wall returns, no terrain; both horizontal ends meet a regular wall cleanly.

items.name: Portão da cidade
items.brief: The city gate from column A upper image: stout cream-gray stone medieval wall gateway with broad central arched opening, dark oak double gate leaves visibly swung OPEN against the inner sides so the passage is clear and transparent. Small warm lanterns beside arch and vertical royal blue/gold banners. Straight crenellated wall top, small capped side piers. Perfectly vertical arch symmetry, no crooked doors. Same frontal slightly elevated view, no towers tilted, no people/road/terrain.

items.name: Portal central
items.brief: The game's magical central PORTAL, not a fountain: a substantial upright circular/arched carved pale stone ring on a low compact base, viewed front-on from same slightly elevated RPG camera, calm luminous sapphire-blue swirling magical surface inside, subtle carved gold-blue rune marks around rim. Medieval fantasy, hand-crafted stone, moderate restrained glow, no sci-fi metal. No huge crystal spikes, no ground halo or people.

items.name: Fonte da praça
items.brief: The plaza fountain from column A center: a round/octagonal pale stone basin with bright blue water, visible inside water surface and front rim in frontal slightly elevated RPG view. Central small stone medieval guardian statue/plinth, four fine water arcs and little sparkles. Same warm sculpted pixel art, charming substantial cream stone rim, compact complete fountain only, no paving/planters/grass/people.
